description: Opt-in only: upload a simplified SCIP JSON index (ADR-0010) to enrich CALLS/IMPORTS with provenance=scip. Call ONLY when the operator explicitly asks to upload/enrich SCIP — never on ordinary query/impact/path turns. Prefer CI (gently-mcp-scip-upload). Provide path or inline index. Requires graph:write. Bodies over 1 MiB are rejected.

connectorId.description: Optional connector id recorded on the generation

index.description: Inline simplified SCIP JSON (documents[]) when not using path

path.description: Path to simplified SCIP JSON on disk (relative to the workspace cwd or absolute)

ref.description: Graph ref / branch (defaults to GENTLY_REF or main)

source.description: Source tag github:org/repo (defaults to this checkout's ambient source)

name: gently_upload_scip
title: Upload a SCIP index
